segments.en:
This is
Grados City...

The city we used to call
New York...

It was here that Eiji and Le Caine
first clashed.

The battle ended in victory
for Eiji and the others,
and I was rescued.

The news spread across the whole
continent as a victory for the Resistance,

and the Resistance's morale
soared.

But that was exactly
Le Caine's scheme.
"Outside the Metropolitan Museum of Art"

Move it!
No dawdling!
Haul out every last piece!!

Behold, you Terrans!
Behold this heap of junk!

Drag it all into the light of day,
and it fades and loses all meaning!

This is the true face of
what you have believed in.

Wake up,
Terrans!

What lies here is nothing but
a mass of idiotic rubbish!
Roanne Demitrich!!
Sir!
Set it ablaze!!

Light the fire with your own hands,
and teach your own people that these
things are utterly worthless!
Yes, sir!

Heh heh heh...
Rage, you rabble.

And dance
in the palm of my hand!
Hah hahahahahaha!

The Resistance has finally
beaten Le Caine!

We don't have to
fear Grados anymore!

Now's the time to rally all our comrades
and take back New York!

That's right!
That's our city!

"Grados City"? What a humiliating name!
We won't let them use it
any longer!!

Stop!
Le Caine is far stronger
than that!

How would you know!
Le Caine's just
the new commander, right?

Heck, if we assassinate
him first and then attack,
we're sure to win!

Besides, he went and torched
the Metropolitan Museum just to get
back at us for losing the battle!

We can't let him do as he
pleases any longer!

That's part of his plan too!
It has to be a trap to lure
the Resistance out!

Take my advice.
Call off the strike
on Le Caine!

You don't understand how much
that burned museum
meant to us!

Eiji...
When it comes down to it,
you're an outsider!
Maybe so...

But I care about
everything in this world!

Please understand...!
If we fail here, we'll
lose everything!

We'd rather you
kept your nose out of it.

We'll show you what our
organization can do!!
SILEEEEEENCE!!
M-Master Asia...

I will not permit any
attack on New York!!

What we must do is make
our organization
stronger still!
But...

Even if you retook the city, you have
no forces to defend it!

The Grados Army will soon
restore its strength with
reinforcements from Cusco.

Then we'd be struck by a
counterattack at once, and our
annihilation would be certain!

Can you not see
even that?!

You're not even
from Gaia!

To us people of the
Gaia Continent, that city
is irreplaceable!

Hmph! So you insist you
will not heed
my words!

Everyone's morale is
higher than it's ever been.

Isn't now the time
for us to rise up?!

Heh... Very well!!
If you would attack New York,
you must first defeat me!

I shall see for myself just
how high this morale of yours is!
Nngh...
Here I comeee!!
Haaaaaaaah!!

What's that?
It's awfully noisy
outside...

What?
What on earth is going on?

Master Asia's holding
down the hawks.
The hawks?

They're the most belligerent bunch
in the whole Resistance.

We'd better get them
under control fast.

I'm going to help Master.
I'll head out ahead of you!
I'll go too!

You don't need to, Big Bro Eiji.
Leave this to us, and think about
the next operation or something.

Vice-Commander Rain is drawing up
the operation plan. We'd like
to leave that to you two.
All right.
Until later, then.

Kanji, we're done here.
Let's gather the other key members
and head to the ops room where Rain is.

segments.en:
Hang on a sec. If we're gathering
people, couldn't we just make an
announcement over the base PA?

If we did that, the hawks
would take over the
ops room.

Besides... we need to explain
the current situation too.
We'll gather them in person.

Hah... There's a nasty
vibe around here.

I hate that kind of thing,
sneaking around behind
people's backs.

Anyway, why are there
trigger-happy types like
these "hawks" at this base?

They're nothing special.
If anything, most of our comrades
feel just the way they do.
They do?

The Resistance is made up of
strong-willed people to
begin with.

Normally, they're people
of action -- comrades
we can count on.

But right now, winning
that battle has them
losing their cool.

You can't blame them... Until now
the Resistance has stuck strictly
to guerrilla operations.

It's never won a battle
out in the open.

I understand wanting to seize
this chance to strike back...

All this restlessness comes from
what everyone in the Resistance
has been feeling all along.

We won the battle, and yet
things are getting
kinda messy...

rows.notes: Segs 9-14 headerless, taken as Eiji continuing his explanation. Seg 5 headerless, Kanji continuing. | [editorial 3] 'What a nasty atmosphere' stiff for Kanji's casual voice | [editorial 14] garbled sentence structure ('the feeling..., breaking out') clarified; same meaning

segments.en: They're still at it?

Against Master Asia, it doesn't matter
how many of them gang up -- it's useless.
He's handling them like children...

Domon and the others
have joined in too...
But is it okay to leave it like this?

No need to worry.
They're so far above the rest,
they can hold back just right.

Once the hawks blow off some
steam, they'll settle down...
Guess so.

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'Master Asia' (glossary full name Master Asia, Undefeated of the East). Seg 4 headerless, Eiji continuing.

segments.en: Still at it...

Let's go somewhere else
before we get dragged in.

rows.notes: Seg 1 headerless; taken as Kanji continuing ('Let's' includes Eiji either way).

segments.en:
Kanji,
hold on a sec.

There are still people we
haven't talked to. It's too early
to start the strategy meeting.

Right...
I wonder where they are...

It may be a pain, but we'll
just have to find them.
Yeah.

Now then...
Anybody around...?

Kaine and the others
are over there.

Oh, so they are.
Let's go see!

Quess! Aren't you supposed
to be doing maintenance
on your machine?
I can't stay in a place like that!

Everyone's out for blood,
with their emotions running wild!

Hahaha...
It's a full-on brawl.
No place for a girl, I guess.

So?
Why'd you drag us
out here?

You guys are
my bodyguards!
Whaaaat!!
Well, obviously!
Nwaaaargh!!
Now, now, calm down, Kaine.

Same old, same old.
Well, let's take it easy.

Those guys are getting along
fine, one way or another.

Looks like we can leave
them be.

We've done what we came for.
On to the next!
Yeah!

rows.notes: Seg 16 headerless, taken as Eiji continuing (Kanji answers 'Yeah!').

segments.en:
Nobody here,
huh...

No...
Anna's over there.

Oh... the girl who'd
been captured by Grados,
right?

Come to think of it, you two
seemed pretty close, Eiji.

Three years ago... when I came from
Grados, Anna was the very first
person who believed in me.

I see. Then hurry on over!
I'll wait here.
Right.

Miss Anna...
We've come a really,
really long way, haven't we?
Yes...

I wonder how everyone
back in New York is doing.
I hope they're safe...
Of course they're safe!

After you got caught,
everyone got split up, but

I bet they're doing fine
somewhere!

Yes...
I'm sure you're right.
Anna...
Oh... Eiji.

I'm sorry, Anna.
I couldn't stop Grados
from capturing you.

It's all right.
After all, it's thanks to you, Eiji,
that I'm still alive.

I was so happy
that you came for me.

Miss Anna!
I was right, wasn't I?

Reading books didn't
drive those guys away,
did it!

After that, if the Resistance
hadn't saved me, I'd have
been in danger too.

See? Unless we fight like
Big Bro Eiji, nothing's
ever gonna change!

Fred, that's not true.
Fighting without weapons
takes a lot of courage.
That's a lie!

It's no lie.
Anna has more courage than me,
and she's much stronger at heart.

But... in the end,
I gave in to force.

Your heart didn't give in.
Anna...
What you've done is admirable.

That's not true.
I was only passing on what
I learned from someone else.
Someone else?
Who's that?

They call her
the Saint of Cusco.
...The Saint of Cusco?

A woman the downtrodden
people hail as a savior,
even as God come again.
God come again?!

Yes... Though I've only
heard rumors of her myself.

The rumors spread from the Cusco
region, south on the Gaia Continent,
so that's what we call her.

In a word, she preaches
nonresistance.
Nonresistance?!

She implicitly criticized
Gresco's policies,

saying that Terrans and Gradosians,
rather than one side discriminating
against the other,

must coexist -- and once she
spoke out for that, she began
to gain more and more supporters.

Without weapons...
She criticizes Gresco?!

That's what makes her
so amazing!

They say even some Grados soldiers
have come to sympathize
with her ideas.

What's she called?
What's that woman's
real name?

Huh?
I don't know...

Only "the Saint of Cusco"...
I've never even seen her face...

The way things are now, we can't
even go to meet her...

The Cusco area connects to
Grados's space. In other words...
it's right under the enemy's thumb.

Yes... But I think it's amazing that
someone there is appealing to
Grados without any weapons.
Yeah...

Sorry to keep you waiting,
Kanji.

Huh?
Where's Anna?

She says she'll stop by the
refugee center on her way.

I see.
Then let's move on.
Yeah...

rows.notes: Seg 3 headerless, Kanji continuing. Segs 9-10 headerless after Anna's 'Yes...', taken as Anna (Fred replies 'Of course they're safe'). Segs 12-13 Fred continuing. Seg 19 Anna continuing. segments.en: Hm?

Anna's standing at the
entrance to the ops room.

Anna,
what are you doing?

It's just...
hard to go in...

Hmm~
So you were waiting
for Eiji, huh?

You sly dog, you!
Eh? Eh?

C-Cut it out...!
Anna, it's about time to start.
Let's go in together.

I don't really... understand
operations or strategy...

Is that what you were
worried about?
Rain...

But...
I really...

I don't understand half this
strategy stuff either!
That's why we talk it over!

Um... Rain, you ARE
the vice-commander,
technically...

It's fi~ne!
Everyone else will figure out
the hard stuff for me.

All I do is make arrangements
so everyone can work smoothly.

Anna, you've always worked
for the movement without
using weapons, right?

The honest opinions that come
from someone in that position
are what we need right now.

Huh...
But... I...

Oh, come on!!
How long are you gonna chat in
the doorway! Nobody can get in!

Go on!
In, in!

Whoa...!
D-Don't push!
Aah!

Ow, ow... Geez!
Elchi, you're
so rough!

Oh? Am I?
Do pardon me!

Well, anyway, it looks like
everyone who could make it
is here now,

so let's
get started.

In the last battle,
we somehow managed
to win.

And on top of that,
we managed to
rescue Anna,

so the Resistance's honor
is totally intact!
Exactly.

But because of it, the
whole Resistance is
getting restless.

Yes...
Several bases have already
been found and attacked.

Here, Master Asia's quick thinking
has kept things in check...
but the other bases can't manage that...

But at this rate, who knows
when the enemy will find
this place too...

We beat Le Caine
once already!

This time we should
just all attack together!

Ugh!
You still don't get
the situation?

Huh?
Don't I?

Le Caine is known
as a strategist, too.

He most likely
lost on purpose.

Lose on purpose?
Why would he do that?

Le Caine just took up his post...
That was a setup to gauge
the Resistance's strength.

If we'd been weaker than he
expected back then, he'd have
crushed us in one go.

The battle with the Iron Gear
must have shown him how strong the
Resistance's organization is.

I see.
So that's why he's letting
us run loose...

Looks like our friend
wants to play whack-a-mole.

Ri~ght! He'll smack us when
we get cocky from winning
and come waltzing out!

To keep that from happening...
we have to act fast.
Do you have a plan?

Yes... It's earlier than planned,
but I want the Iron Gear to head
for the Asia Continent at once.

Go to the Asia Continent?
And that'll fix things?

A lot of people overestimate
the Iron Gear's strength.

They think that with the Iron
Gear's help, they can beat Grados.

So it's better if the Iron Gear,
the symbol of victory, disappears
for a while. That's the idea, right?
Yes...

Why not?
Going to the Asia Continent
was our goal from the start.

Either way, you need a
Land Ship to travel
across the continent.

I'm all fooor it!
Once we leave the continent, the
Iron Gear won't be "wanted" anymore,

so we can work out in the open
as haulers!

Gather allies as we travel!
Perfect for recruiting
comrades!
Sounds kinda fun.

All right!
I'm in too!
Same goes for us!
Then it's settled!

So tell us how we're
gonna get over there.

All right.
Could you all look at this?

There's only one corridor
linking the Gaia Continent
and the Asia Continent...

This spot, where Paradigm City
stands, is the only corridor
between the continents.

Naturally, we'll have to
pass through Paradigm City
too.

But hey, the City's been
sealed off, right?

The Iron Gear and the Resistance
are both "wanted," y'know.
They won't let us through!

True. People alone, maybe,
but the Iron Gear's over 100 m in size.
That'd be kinda hard to hide.

Don't worry!
I've already taken care of it.

Don't tell me...
You're gonna wreck the city and
force our way through...?

No...!
If we did that, we'd be no
different from the Grados Army!

O-Of course not!
Our staff are working on
settling it through talks.

So the operation's
already in motion.

Yes... But there's no telling
if the Grados Army will just
sit back and watch...

That's why...
we must keep where and when
we're heading a total secret.

You absolutely must not tell
anyone outside this room
about the operation.
That goes for you too, Anna.
Oh... Yes...

I'll explain the rest once
we're ready to set out,
so leave it to me.
Got it.

So we just need to keep
the Iron Gear ready to
move out at any time.
I'm counting on you.

Leave it to me!
All right, everyone, get to work!!

We've had so many battles
lately, the hull's
starting to fall apart.

Then get it in perfect shape!
That's what the dock is for!
Yeah, yeah!

segments.en:
Here's
the loading list.

Impressive!
That was fast!

Come on, everyone, divide up
the jobs and let's get moving!
Roger!
Excuuuse me!

Ah...!
You can't come in here!
We're in an important meeting.

I came here on
real business!

Fred... wasn't it?
What is it you need?

A new underground paper
came out, and some old guy
asked me to give it to you.
Some... old guy...?

Look, here it is! It says the
"Saint of Cusco Corps" is
heading for New York!

What?
The "Saint of Cusco Corps"?

Amazing!
So the rumors were true!

There were rumors that she and
her supporters had headed
for New York, but...

I wonder what kind of
person she is.

(The Saint of Cusco...
 Is that those nonresistance
 people Eiji told me about...?)

Oh!
There's a photo of her
face in here!
What? Really?!

It's out of focus, and in black
and white too... Hard to tell...
Huh...?

What's wrong,
Eiji?

Something's
bothering me.
I'm going to check it out!

Hey...!
Wait up, Eiji!

What's gotten into him
all of a sudden...

Don't tell me...!
He's going all the way
to New York...?
What?!

Hold on!
What's with you all
of a sudden?

I want to see the "Saint of Cusco"
heading for New York
with my own eyes.
The "Saint of Cusco"?

Wait!
I'm coming with you.

Hey, you two!
Wait right theeere!

Don't worry!
We're just going to scout
things out!

Wait!
Don't go running off
on your own!

Rain,
let's let them go.

Amuro...
But right now...

If Eiji, who's usually so calm,
is in that much of a hurry,
he must have a reason.

The Iron Gear's maintenance
will take time. Sending them
won't hold up the work.

It's dangerous! We should
leave the scouting to
the local members.

The Grados fleet is coming
through the gate that
opened in Cusco, right?

Yes...
According to Eiji...
But what about it?

That's just it... Right now we need
every scrap of information
on that gate we can get.

If they can make contact with
the Saint of Cusco, we might
get some useful information.
That's true, but...

Quess,
wait!
No waaay!

Quess!
What is it?!

I'm going too!
Eiji wasn't acting normal
just now, was he?
Yeah... I'm counting on you.

Okay!
See ya!
Ah!

Lieutenant!!
Why aren't you stopping her?

There's nothing to worry about.
She's growing up.

Huh?
Is she, now?

If it's scouting, aren't
we better suited
for the job?

Right, right. For covert ops,
leave it to the Dragonar Team!

So, that settles it.
Let's go!
Yeah!

Nooo!
I can't have too many
of you leaving!

Right.
Dragonar Team, stay
here with me.

There's a mountain of
cargo loading to do, too.

Whoa!
Sounds like a blast!

Sigh...
We'd be delighted
to do it~
Kanji, this way!

Hey...
What are we doing
coming out here?

There's a shuttle
hidden here.
A shuttle?

segments.en:
Wow.
You had something
like this?

It's a Grados
space shuttle.

It can't carry much, but it
should fool the enemy's eyes
to some extent.
I see...

Just to confirm -- did you
load the machines?

Yeah, all set.
The specs didn't match,
so it was a bit of a hassle.

Looks like you loaded two...
What models are they?

No...
All I loaded
was one FT.

Isn't the other one
your Layzner, Eiji?

That's strange...
There are three machines
loaded in all.

There shouldn't have been
anything aboard at first...

Eiji,
I'm coming too!

Quess!
When did you...!

What's the big idea!
Tagging along without
asking!

I got permission,
I'll have you know.

You guys aren't
Newtypes, so you
need me!

Ugh... It's useless saying
anything to her...

Eiji... There's no helping it.
Let's take her along.

Wha~t's that supposed to mean!
So annoyiiing~!

We're counting on you,
Quess...
All right, let's head out!

rows.notes: Seg 2 Eiji continuing; segs 8-9 Kanji continuing; seg 11 Eiji continuing; seg 16 Quess continuing; seg 18 Kanji continuing; seg 21 headerless 'let's go' kept unattributed (Eiji or Kanji). Seg 6/10: Eiji first counts two machines besides his own, then three in total -- the source's arithmetic kept as is.

segments.en:
That way's dangerous!
We're headed for New York,
remember!

My brain just went
PIKIIIN!

Telling me we won't run into
the enemy this way!

"PIKIIIN," my foot!
You're making fun of me...!

Eijiii!
Kanji's going the
wrong way!

What?
Kanji, this is no time
to be fooling around!

Sorry... I'm just not used
to flying the shuttle...

Then I'll
take over!

Haha... Sorry about that.
I'll do it properly.

Honestly, who's the real
dead weight here...

(Dammit...
 I've got a feeling
 I just can't beat her.)

rows.notes: Seg 1 [jp] (Newtype-flash sound, Kanji mocking Quess) -> 'PIKIIIN'. Seg 2 Kanji continuing; seg 4 Quess continuing (calling to Eiji). | [editorial 3] 'What "PIKIIIN"!' unidiomatic retort | [editorial 9] 'who's the one holding who back' tangled; [jp] = dead weight

segments.en:
Hey, aren't we heading
in a weird direction again?

Ohhh...
Some mysterious force is
pulling us off course...
How terrifying...
If you don't knock it off...!
Correcting course nooow!

rows.notes: Seg 2 Kanji continuing; seg 5 headerless, Kanji giving in.

segments.en:
The enemy won't spot us
easily here. How about
around here?

Right.
Let's land.

Okay, from here on
we go overland.

Roger!
Quess, you mind the
shuttle, okay?

What's that supposed to mean!
I came all the way here
with you guys!

You'd stand out too much in town.
You'd have to look a lot grubbier.

Whaaat?
Nobody told me that!

If danger comes, contact us.
I'm counting on you.

Ugh, fine!
I get it!

rows.notes: [jp] -> 'mind the shuttle'.

segments.en: Well then, let's go!
Yeah!

Heh heh...
Who's minding the
shuttle, you say?

I'll just have to tail them
without getting noticed!

rows.notes: Seg 3 Quess continuing.

segments.en:
Le Caine...
I hear you made quite a show of it.
So word has already reached your ears?

You know why I have summoned you,
do you not?

I am well aware of it,
Father!

Pointless slaughter and destruction
will only turn the populace against us.
You have changed, Father.

Perhaps... after three years in this
land, you have come down with this
"Terra Sickness" I hear of?
Terra Sickness?

That is what they call it in the
rumors going around the homeland.

As one pillar of your occupation
policy, Father, you proclaimed the
Gradosization of Terran culture.

To that end, you even established
the Culture Correction Squad...

...and began the correction with this
great city, the very symbol of
the Gaia Continent.

And yet, you did not see it through.
You left two strongholds sealed off,
but still standing.

The New York Library and the
Metropolitan Museum of Art, you mean...
Yes...

A half-hearted policy only gives the
Terran rabble cause to make light
of us.

This wicked culture must be burned
to the ground at once!

As you know, the burning of the
Metropolitan Museum of Art
is already complete.

Next is the New York Library.
You have no objection, I trust?
Father...
Hmm...

Father... Is something
not to your liking?

Father! I am only carrying out
your policies faithfully!
Why can you not understand that!

Le Caine...
You are still young.

There is far too much you have
yet to learn...
Father...

Hm? Karla! We are in a meeting.
Do not call me away for nothing!

My apologies,
Lord Le Caine!
Well? What is it?

We have reports of some strange people
heading this way from Cusco!

"Strange people" tells me nothing!
Report clearly!!

Yes, sir! It is a suspicious group
calling itself
"the Saint of Cusco Corps."
The Saint of Cusco?

Yes... It's most likely some sort
of religious group, I believe...

But the Terran rabble in the city have begun
gathering in large numbers.

The Terran rabble? Do they mean to
hold a rally or something? I can
make no sense of this at all...

I'm coming right away. Have the
files ready and wait for me!
Yes, sir!

Pardon me, Father...
I must now return to
my military duties.

Let us continue this conversation
another day.

So this is the report on
the Saint of Cusco...

It says she claims Terrans and
Gradosians should live together
without discrimination...

Roanne Demitrich.
Were you the one who
compiled these files?

Yes! Though I can hardly call
the material very accurate...

It is a fact that her message has
gained no small amount of support
among the people...

So she is implicitly criticizing
the policies of Grados.

To think such a creature has been left
to run loose until now...

What's more, all the way from Cusco
to Grados City, they haven't been
stopped at a single checkpoint!

What...? What does that mean?
Is there some route
we are unaware of?

No, they are approaching
by the most common route.

And we've lost no soldiers either.
It's a strange business...

Your Excellency, the party will soon
enter Grados City.

Hmm... To march so boldly
on our very headquarters...

What in the world do they intend
to do in this city?!

Most likely... they mean to
petition His Excellency Gresco
directly, I believe.
A direct petition?

"The Terrans and we
must live together..."

They come all this way
to spout that drivel?!

If I may be so bold, even among the
Grados soldiers, some have been
moved by...

Silence!! This city is now as good
as our holy ground!!

Rabble like that,
who lead the people astray...

...must not be allowed to set
a single foot in this place!!

Go!
Karla!!
Yes, sir!!

Seg 34: [jp] -> 'the Saint of Cuzco's Band' ([jp] unverified; 'Band' chosen over 'Corps'). Seg 14/20: [jp] kept literal 'New York Library'. [jp] -> 'Terran(s)' as in dlg_3986_09447_01. segments.en:
So this is the big city,
New York...

Walking the streets like this, you can
really see how wrecked it is...

Grados won't accept any culture
but its own... That's why
repairing the city is forbidden.
Man, that's rotten...

You two... you're outsiders, huh?
Better not stick around here long.

Sorry.
We'll leave right away.
Take care, now.

Thanks,
ma'am.
See ya!

rows.notes: Seg 7: Kanji's [jp] -> 'ma'am' (the civilian is thereby female).

segments.en:
Kanji, people are gathering
over there. Let's go take a look!

Hey, here they come!
Isn't that them?

Yeah... I'd say there's
no doubt about it.

You women there!
Halt!!

You are not permitted
to go any further!!

Turn back, right here
and now!

Take one more step, and every last
one of you will be shot on the spot!!

Those people aren't armed!
Shouldn't we help them?

They must have been through this
more than once or twice on their
way here...
Let's watch for a while.
This is the heart of their turf!
Just hold on!

You...!
Did you not hear me!!

Halt!
I said halt!!

We bear no weapons. We only wish to
meet His Excellency Gresco.

Please, I beg you,
let us pass.

As if His Excellency would meet
a woman like you!!

...Hm?
Y-You're...!!
Ah... Sis...!

Heh heh heh...! Don't tell me
this woman is
the Saint of Cusco!
You know her?

This is
Albatro Mill
Julia Asuka!

She was once a pilot
in the Grados Army!

Hah hah hah hah! You, a saint!!
Hah! Don't make me laugh!!

So now you take the name of God
to lead the people astray!!

Karla... It was only after I came
down to Terra that I finally
realized the truth.

Yes...
in the sacred land of Cusco...

Don't talk nonsense!
What could there possibly be
in Cusco!

All that's there is the gate that
leads to the Grados homeworld!!

You and I have both lost
someone precious to us.

But I was able to cast
that hatred away.

Someday, the time will come
when you understand too.

What are you saying!! What would
I understand!! As if I could ever
be led astray!!

Never mind, shoot her!
Execute her right here!!
B-But...

Stop this. Surely you did not come
to this land because you wanted
to kill people.

You came all the way to Terra
for the sake of the families you love.
Uh, uhh...
Now, lower your weapons.

I am only heading to Grados City
to talk. I am not your enemy,
I assure you.
Ah... ahh...

Shoot! You there!
What are you doing!!

She's no god!
She's just a woman!!
B-But...

...All of you!!
You won't obey my orders?!

Argh! Give me that!!
I'll shoot her dead myself!!

Please stop!
Lady Karla!

His Excellency Gresco
has given no such order!
These are Lord Le Caine's orders!

Please wait!
Lady Karla!

If she is a former Grados soldier,
she should be tried under
military law!

Besides, they have not violated
the Culture Correction Law either.

I believe it would be wise to refrain
from shooting them rashly.

Tch...
Roanne...!

Lady Karla, let us withdraw for now.
A crowd is gathering.
I don't need you to tell me that!!

Julia! Don't think
this is over!!

Argh!
We're pulling out!!

The Grados guys
took off...

Hey, Eiji. That lady with the
blue hair... she's your sister?
Yeah...
(That was... three years ago...)
Stop it, Sis!

This fight
is pointless!
Please, listen to me!!

Eiji... Even if you are
my own brother,
I will never forgive you!

You... killed Lieutenant JG Gale,
who was my whole life.

You must atone
for that!

No! That's not how it was!
It's not, Sis!

I'm not the one
who killed Gale!

Eiji! I don't want to hear
any of your excuses!
Eiji, prepare yourself!!

Sis! In the end,
he told me...

...that this beautiful world
must be protected!

That's what he said!
Sis!!

It can't be...
He was Gradosian
through and through...

No... No matter what I hear,
the way I am now... I...
I...!

After that, Sis and I
were separated.
But... she was alive...

...here on the Gaia Continent,
under the heel of Grados...

Oh... So the Saint of Cusco is
a former Grados soldier.

My apologies. We let them
into the city.
No, you were wise not to act rashly.

Make martyrs of people like that
too easily, and it only causes
more trouble.

We must strip them of every scrap of
public support before we dispose
of them.

Heh heh... This so-called saint
who leads the people astray...
I shall unmask her myself!!

rows.notes: Seg 21 etc.: Eiji's [jp] -> 'Sis'. Seg 51/54: [jp] -> 'Lady Karla'. Seg 58: [jp] object left plural 'them' (Roanne speaks of [jp] just before). Seg 72/75: [jp] 'Lieutenant Gale'; [jp] -> 'Gale' (Gale romanization as in dlg_3986_09447 / library, not in glossary). Seg 67-82: flashback. Seg 78: [jp] -> 'he' (Gale, established male in seg 81 [jp]). Seg 85: [jp] = the Gaia Continent. Seg 90: [jp] -> 'them' (Julia's group), 'her' kept in seg 92 for the saint. | [accuracy 48] 'You men' assumed the soldiers' gender; [jp] is neutral | [editorial 12] iikara is Eiji holding Kanji back; 'Just trust me!' read oddly as the answer to Kanji's warning (accuracy flag) | [editorial 41] soldier is wavering, not in pain; 'Ugh, ugh' read as pain (accuracy flag) | [editorial 85] 'on Gaia' reads like a planet; consistent with 'the Gaia Continent' in row 15 k12 and corpus (24x)

segments.en:
So that's where the Grados Army's
supreme commander is.
Yeah...

Sis... Do you really mean to
meet with Gresco...?

Hey!
He's come out!
Le Caine...!

You, the so-called Saint of Cusco!
What business brings you here!

I am here to meet His Excellency
Gresco. Please let us pass.

I govern this city. No one passes
without my permission!

"Saint"... What a fitting title.
But! I am not so soft!

I will prove that you are
nothing but a mere
woman!!

Well, "Saint"! Will you show us
a miracle in the face of
my guns!!
...It's her!!
Your Excellencyyy~!!
I-I have a requeeest~!
I humbly beg a requeeest!!

If, if you're gonna kill her anyway,
then hand her down to me! To me,
I beg you!

Please!
I'm begging you!

What would a demon want
with a saint!

I've got a mountain of grudges
against that woman!

She made a damn fool of me
again and again!!

Very well...
I shall give the saint to the demon.
Thank you, siiir!!

Heh heh heh!
Well, hey!
Long time no see!!
Could it be... you're...!

Hah hah!!
I'm honored you
remember me!!

Now I'm gonna make you less than a
saint -- less than even an ordinary
woman!

Argh! Don't you stand there acting all
prim and smug at me!!
Don't you look down on me!!
Hyahahaha!

A saint, huh! Fwahahaha!! Then you
must be different from an ordinary
woman, of course!!
Stop iiit!!
Y-You bastard!!
Guhaaah!!
Ah... Eiji!

Damn it...
That hurt, ya hear!

Come on, Gosterro!
I'll take you on!!

Hahhahaha!!
This is too good!!
Eijiii!!

I'm gonna pay you back
plenty for that!
Ngh...!
Hyahahahahaha!

I'll make every bone in your
body creak!!
Guhaaah!!

Eiji! You jumped out too soon!
We won't have time to
contact Quess...!
Sorry...

Well, now we've gotta at least
get those people out of here.

Eh, with any luck, we'll just
end up as prisoners.

Eiji! So your sister
is the saint.

But just what do you
intend to do about
this situation?

Fwahahaha! Still the same
soft little brat as ever,
huh!

Now!
Die!

You're the fool here!
You're nothing but an Oldtype!!
What?
Nugoooh!!

rows.notes: Seg 19/23: [jp] (Le Caine's word for Gosterro) -> 'demon'. Seg 15 [jp] / 16 [jp]: Gosterro's mock-archaic groveling rendered as 'humbly beg'. Seg 32: sexual innuendo kept at the same strength. Seg 54: speaker header is Narration, but it is Quess's voice arriving off-screen (she appears in row 20; 'Oldtype' is her word, cf. 'Oldtypes' in another slice); 'you' left unaddressed (Gosterro or Le Caine). Seg 52: [jp] -> 'soft little brat'.

segments.en:
What is this...
They broke through our
air defense network...?!
No way...!

Quess?! I told you
to stay behind!

I sensed danger,
so I came, didn't I!
You should be thanking me!

Kanji!
Let's get to our machines!
OK!

Heh... It seems I must take
care of them first.

Eijiiii!! I'll send you and your sis
to the next world together,
nice and cozy!
Le Caine!

I don't want to believe you're
the same kind of man
as this guy!
Wh-What did you say?!
What are you getting at?
How about a wager?

I want you to fight us using only
the forces that are here right now.
And if I win?

Then you can do whatever you like
with me and these people.
And if it goes the other way?

You never lay a finger on these
people again!
That's all!!

Heh heh... So our forces are
roughly even...

Very well.
I accept your terms.

I thank you for your
honorable decision!

Hahhahah!!
This is too good!!

Heh heh... This world prepares
one amusing diversion after
another for me.

Here I come!
Eiji!!

Heh heh... That was quite
some teamwork.

It may have been a surprise attack,
but the fact remains you beat me.

I shall grant you the victory in this
contest... for now.
You ain't getting awaaay!!

If you're running, then
I'm taking the saint!!
Fwahahaha!!

Stop this unsightly behavior!
Do you mean to disgrace me?!

Hwaaah!
F-Forgive meee~

Whoa!
Whoaaaa!
F-Forgive meee~

Hmph!
You vulgar wretch!!

To begin with, letting the enemy
get this far in was a blunder
on our army's part...

We must overhaul our air defense
surveillance from the ground up!

Eiji, you have entertained me today.
We shall meet again!

That guy... For someone who just lost,
he's taking it pretty well.

Is it just the arrogance of
the strong... or...

Well, no point hanging around.
Let's go.

Wait.
I want to talk to my sister.
I know how you feel, but...

As long as we don't make
any careless moves,
Le Caine won't lay a hand on us.

Sigh...
Guess there's no helping it.
Sis!
Eiji...

You're alive...
Sis...

It seems you are still...
fighting against
Grados......

I've got lots of friends with me
now. Let me take you to them, Sis.

No. I cannot join
the Resistance.

Nor, of course, do I intend to join
hands with Grados, or with any other
force that opposes it.
Why...?

I came here to talk with
His Excellency Gresco.

I intend to stay in this city until
His Excellency agrees to
my request.

You're still enlisted, right? If they
catch you, they'll shoot you for
desertion! This is way too reckless...!

Just as you have
your own battle to fight...

...I too have something
I must do.
In my own way.
Farewell, then.
Sis...!

Eiji...
Does she have her reasons?

I don't know...
Sis... why...?

She's... dead serious. She's trying
to stop the fighting in a different
way from us.

That's why she can't
come with us.
A different way from us...?

Calling for peace without weapons
or anyone to back her up...

That's something we could never do
right now. You understand,
don't you...?

So, Eiji, let your sister do
things her own way for a while.
Sis...

rows.notes: [editorial 6] consistency: the Resistance capitalised as in dlg_4012_09500_02 and the corpus

segments.en:
Lord Le Caine! His Excellency
Gresco is calling for you.

Father? I met with him only a short
while ago. Whatever could he want?

It seems Lord Arthea, commander of
the Asia Front Army, has arrived.

Hmph! No doubt he's come
to demand supplies.

Understood.
Tell him I'll be there at once.

That was quick,
Black Knight Arthea.

I hear you came all the way
from Asia alone...?

With my Knight Ouga, it is
a simple matter.

It seems a fine machine. Worthy of one
who bears the name Black Knight.
You honor me with your words.

However, the war on the Asia
Continent... is proving more
troublesome than expected.

As commander of the invasion force,
I have no excuse to offer.

Reinforcements from the homeland
are arriving one after another.

Once the situation on the Gaia Continent
settles, we will be able to send forces
to the Asian front.
I am grateful for your consideration.

I hear... the subversives here
have grown more active as well.

Mm... The Resistance appears to
have gained new strength.

The Iron Gear, I take it. It seems
the supply units have taken
most of the damage.
You knew of it?

Yes. Some things about that ship
made no sense to me... so I had
my men look into it.

And interestingly, it seems a good
many people from space have joined
that ship.
From space...?

They know how to fight
in space.

Left unchecked,
they will become a threat.

To the Grados homeland, and to my
own homeland, Galfa, alike...

You believe a single battleship
could change the state
of the world?

Many aboard the Iron Gear are former
haulers, with connections among
the people of other continents.

Some of those people will likely
take their side.

In time, they may well become
a great power.

Hah hah hah!
You worry over nothing.

A mere land battleship! With the
might of our army, we can make short
work of it any time we please!

I wonder about that.
I sense a strange power in them.

And you yourself, Lord Le Caine,
seem to have had a hard fight
in that last battle...

The Resistance stands behind them.
That battle was groundwork for
wiping them out.

For a force the size of a battleship,
they are exceptional...
That much I will grant.

But...
in the end, they are merely
one unit.

Are the arrangements for their
annihilation in place?
Of course, Father.

The Resistance has grown cocky from
victory. Its morale is up, and the
mood for revolt is rising.

Thanks to these moves by the rebels,
we have already located a number
of their bases.

I see...
Just what I'd expect of
Lord Le Caine.

A scheme to catch the Resistance
in a single net...
It is sure to succeed.

Once the Gaia Continent is pacified,
I too can concentrate on
conquering Asia.

Hmph... With this, Gaia's rebels
will be swept away, and nothing will
hinder our advance into Asia.

You will have no more excuses
then, Lord Arthea...!
Your point is well taken.

I shall return to the front at once
and take command of the
Asia Front Army.

I am counting on you, Arthea. The road
to pacifying Terra is a long one...

Show me work worthy of
the name Black Knight.

See that you do not sully the name
of Emperor Galfa.

Yes, sir!
I will stake my life on it!

So that is Arthea, the one
they call the Black Knight.

He is the man who will one day be
your right hand. It is time we put
him to work.

With the reinforcements from the
homeland, our advance will speed up
whether we like it or not.

Mm...!
Exactly so, Le Caine.

To the masses, it should appear that
the stalled conquest of the Terra
Realm advanced with your arrival.

Heh...! You are far too
protective, Father.

You need not go that far for me.
I, Le Caine, will pacify the Terra
Realm by my own strength.

I expect great things of you,
Le Caine.

By the way, Father, that is not the
only reason you summoned me,
is it?

Mm... It concerns how to deal with
this so-called Saint of Cusco.

So you know of her
as well, Father.

This woman who calls herself the
Saint of Cusco has already
entered the city.

Unfortunately, under current law,
we cannot simply pass judgment
on that sort as we please.

However, with but a single order from
you, Father, who even now hold
supreme authority...

...we could remove them
at once.

If they have broken no law,
then leave them be.

A certain amount of anti-war activity
is necessary to build a society.

Father...?!
What has come over you!

It is plain that they are
criticizing the policies
of Grados!

I believe we should enact new laws
and take measures so that no more
of their kind appear!

Mm...
New laws will likely be needed.

But there is no need to rush.
We are already the rulers...
Yes...!

Well done, Le Caine.
Leave the rest to me.

You are to tighten the crackdown
on the Resistance once again.

...Understood. I will move the
operation to its second phase.

It is somewhat ahead of my schedule,
but it will surely bear fruit.
Then I shall take my leave...

Now then...
what to do...

Seg 27: [jp] -> 'take their side' ([jp] = Iron Gear crew). Seg 34: [jp] -> 'groundwork' (Le Caine framing his hard fight as a deliberate step). Seg 44-45: speaker header Le Caine for both; seg 45 'You will have no more excuses' addressed to Arthea. segments.en:
Sorry...
That was all for nothing.

Not at all. We got combat data
on the enemy, too.

Besides, you found out your sister's
alive. Isn't that great?

You two! We're still in enemy
territory, so don't let your
guard down.

Right. Let's stay on full alert
so we don't get followed.
"Depart" is now available.

rows.notes: Seg 5: system line [jp] -> 'The ship can now depart.' | [proofread 5] style sheet: [jp] system line = '"Depart" is now available.'

segments.en:
Eiji...
Thank goodness... You're safe.
Yeah...

So...
did you get to meet the Saint of Cusco?
Yeah...

You won't believe it!
The Saint of Cusco turned out to be
Eiji's big sister!
What?!
Uh... her name was...

Albatro Mill Julia Asuka...
My... my own flesh-and-blood sister.
Is that really true, Eiji?
Yeah...

Eiji,
I'm so happy for you.

You haven't seen your family
ever since you left Grados,
have you?

So...
where's Julia?
She's... not here.
Huh...?

She stayed behind of her own free will,
to talk things over with Admiral Gresco...
B-But that's...!

It can't be helped...
Right now, we're in no position
to throw down our weapons.
Good work on the recon mission!

Seriously! I'm beat!
Who knows what would've happened
if I hadn't been there!

Hahaha... Thanks to you,
we somehow made it back in one piece.

Sounds like...
it was pretty rough.
In more ways than one...
How's the Iron Gear doing?

Well... preparations for departure
are mostly done.
It'll be ready to set out tomorrow.

Maintenance on your machines
will be finished by tonight, too.

Get some rest for today.
You must be tired, right?

Phew~ That's a relief.
Well then, I'll go take it easy for a bit.

Ugh~!
I feel so gro~ss!
Shower, shower!

Well,
see you later.
Yeah!

Good night,
Kanji.
Yeah, good night.
Now the~n, what should I do...

rows.notes: Seg 11 has no header; read as Anna continuing. Seg 16 (Quess) [jp] -> 'Admiral Gresco'. Seg 17 [jp] kept as a trailing 'B-but that's...!'. Seg 18: Kanji means they can't follow Julia's unarmed way because they can't lay down arms. | [editorial 16] redundant 'chose... of her own will' and a full stop splitting one sentence | [editorial 31] 'You bet!' read oddly as an answer to 'see you later' (accuracy flag)

segments.en:
Hm?
Looks like someone's in the ops room.

About our next operation...
First off, how are we going to
get into Paradigm City?
Could you walk us through the plan?

Let's see... Paradigm City is a special
city, self-governed by a giant company
called the Paradigm Corporation.

The person who holds control
over it is Alex Rosewater.

A lot about that person is a mystery,
but anyone who could strike a deal with
Grados must be a skilled politician.

So we just go ask
this Alex directly?

No...
Going directly would be a bit...

We'll ask a go-between
to broker it for us.
A go-between?

She means a Negotiator.
So, what's the name?

Roger Smith.
You haulers must have heard
of him, right?
Whew~!

This man...
can he be trusted?

Word is he's the best
Negotiator in Paradigm City.

I hear he's a real gentleman,
so I think we can trust him.

But if the negotiations fail, or the
Grados Army attacks us, it could turn
into a battle in the city streets.

If that happens, our relationship
with Paradigm City will be
absolutely ruined.

Paradigm City is an important
supply base for the
Grados Army, too.

They won't recklessly
start a battle in the streets.

But if I were the enemy commander, I'd
let us slip through the corridor, then
seal off the city and cut our retreat!

That way, the enemy forces in Asia
could move in and catch
the Iron Gear in a pincer.

Either way,
it's a dangerous gamble...

Even so, we have no choice but to
push forward. We're carrying the
hopes of a great many people.

I'm sorry...
There's no foolproof plan.

Anyway, if you can get through
Paradigm City, you should be able to
contact a powerful resistance group.
A powerful resistance group?

GEAR, the defense organization
that protects Asia.
It's a full-fledged regular army.

GEAR's headquarters is in a city
called Hoshimi, in the southern
part of the continent.

Once you reach the Asia Continent,
head there first.

Got it.
So we just need to visit
GEAR headquarters in Hoshimi.

Before that, though,
we need to make contact
with Roger Smith.

Let's take the Iron Gear
up close to Paradigm City.
Right!

Yo!
What's everybody huddled up
talking about?
You still haven't gone to rest?

I was taking a walk.
I've been cooped up in
cramped places this whole time.

Good timing.
We're just about to settle
on our operational plan.

Let's hear what
you think too, Kanji.

Kanji, are you all right?
Aren't you tired?
Yeah, I'm fine.

Never mind me -- looks like you were
in the middle of something, so go on.

Right.
So, next up is
the matter of supplies...

So they kept working out the plan
even while I was gone.
Well, of course they did...

rows.notes: Segs 3-5 (Rain): Alex Rosewater referred to neutrally ('that person') since the line itself does not settle it. Segs 8-10: JP plays on Jiron not knowing the word [jp] (Rag glosses it as [jp]); rendered as Rain: 'go-between' / Jiron: 'A go-between?' / Rag: 'She means a Negotiator.' Seg 11 [jp] aimed at Rag/Jiron -> 'You haulers'. [jp] -> Hoshimi, [jp] -> GEAR (not in glossary). Seg 20 [jp] -> 'the corridor'. | [editorial 7] 'Not directly, that's a bit...' was clumsy; same trailing hesitation | [editorial 41] 'More importantly' is stiff for soreyori; also drops the added 'I cut you off' (accuracy flag) | [proofread 0] [jp] is the same base room called 'the ops room' in dlg_4012_09500_00 (r0 k73, r7 k1); 'briefing room' was the only variant

segments.en:
Well...
guess I'll turn in soon...
Mmmnnn...
Nnngh...?!

Gaaah!!
That's the emergency alarm!
What the hell is going on?!

Elchi!
Is it an enemy attack?!

I don't know!
Anyway, hurry and load
the rest of the supplies!
Got it!
I'll get the ship's engines going!
Please do!

Captain!
Contact headquarters!
Right!

Janous Team!
Can you hear me?
If you can, respond!
Th-This is the Janous Team!

The Grados Army is closing in
to surround the base.

It's a huge army!
We might be done for!
Don't give up, Scott!!

We've been through this kind
of thing plenty of times before!

Anyway, there's a crazy number of 'em!
We're heading back your way for now!

So those vermin have
finally sniffed us out!

It looks like we'll have to
abandon this base as well...

...Were we
followed here?

No...
Looking at how this siege is laid out...

It seems they had been
preparing for this carefully.

This is Elchi of the Iron Gear!
What on earth is happening?

The enemy is here!
Are your launch preparations complete?

We're still working.
It'll be done in two or three minutes.
Good! Excellent!

As soon as you're ready,
the Iron Gear is to set out
and head for Paradigm City!
Roger!
Everyone, listen well!!

This base is already
surrounded by a great
Grados army!

We must break through their encirclement
and move to a new base!

We will now launch an
all-out charge, with
the Iron Gear at its center!!

Once through the encirclement, each unit
will scatter, go into hiding, and bide
its time until we regroup.

I shall command the rear guard!
The Iron Gear's launch is the signal
to charge! All hands, go!!

Dammit!
The enemy's attacking already?!

Huff... huff... huff...
Is everyone here?

All of the Iron Gear's
members are present.

We'll be in combat the moment we launch.
If you're changing the formation, hurry.
Got it!
Hey, Kanji!

We got some new equipment ready
while you guys were away!
Put it to good use!

OK!
I'll check the equipment.

Machine Revive Lv3
and Item Revive Lv2
are now available.

I see.
There's more new equipment I can use.
Next, I'll check the notice from HQ.

Eiji, Scott,
Roddy and Barts
have left the unit.

The Layzner,
Vifam SP and Neofam
have been removed from the unit.

Eiji's Layzner and the Janous Team
are operating separately... I need a
lineup that doesn't rely on them...

Domon and Master Asia
have left the unit.

Besides Eiji, Domon and Master Asia are
leaving the "Infantry Squad" too...
That hurts...

Well... as long as I've got George
and Sai Saici in the "Infantry Squad,"
I can manage somehow...

It's not like hand-to-hand fighting
breaks out all that often, anyway.

Anyway, right now the "Mech Squad"
is what matters! I'd better hurry
and reorganize it.

rows.notes: Seg 2 has no header; read as Kanji's waking groan (could be the alarm sound). Seg 9: Amuro tells Elchi ([jp]) to contact HQ. [jp] -> 'Janous Team' (glossary [jp] = Janous). Segs 50-51: [jp] -> 'Master Asia' (glossary nickname) rather than 'Undefeated of the East' for readability in narration and Kanji's [jp]. [jp]/[jp] follow the tutorial's 'Infantry Squad'/'Mech Squad'. [jp] -> 'Vifam SP' (not in glossary). | [editorial 47] system line aligned to '<name> has left the unit.' | [editorial 48] system line aligned to 'removed from the unit' (dlg_4818_10306_00) / 'the unit' form | [editorial 50] system line aligned to '<name> has left the unit.' | [proofread 49] grammar: 'X, plus Y are' -- comma + 'plus' left the plural verb without a compound subject

segments.en:
Grados Army
Resistance Annihilation Force

Very well!
All forces, sortie!!

Never look back!
Look only ahead and charge forward!!
Iron Gear, launching!
So it's finally beginning...

The Iron Gear will break
through the siege for sure.

Heh... And we
follow up behind it.
Don't get careless.
Yes, Master!!
Is the Janous Team here?!

Yes, sir!
We're ready to sortie!

Listen...
You will serve as the rear guard
alongside me.
Rear guard?

It means covering our allies'
retreat right to the end.

In other words,
we're the last ones out.

Wh-Wh-Wh--
Why us?!

I need your ship,
the "Janous."

You're going to use the "Janous"?
No way, it still hasn't been
fully repaired!

Then will you just let it
fall into Grados hands?
That's...

We must cut a path out for
the Iron Gear, whatever it takes.

We will draw the enemy's eyes
to the Janous.

You mean you're using
the Janous as a decoy?

But...
Then... us too?

Don't worry.
Master Asia and Domon
will be with you.

I will guarantee
your lives.

But...
I cannot save the Janous...
Please understand.

I see...
But if that...
saves everyone...

Yeah...
Hey! Scott!
You think so too, right?

Ha... hahaha...
Yeah...
If it saves everyone...
Let's do it, Scott!

All right!
Just you watch!
Damn you, Grados!!

Ha-ha~!
That's the spirit!

Let's go!
To the Janous!
Yeah!

Heh...
Young men like that
are hard to come by.
They are...

Now then, shall we
be off as well?
Yes, let's go!
Engines are running great!

Ready anytime,
Elchi!

Alri~ght!
Commence the charge!

Commander!
The Iron Gear has emerged.

Your prediction was right
once again,
Roanne Demitrich.

However...
the enemy is using
powerful jamming.

The only way to pinpoint
their location is by sight.

No need to panic.
They're already rats in a trap.

This is the West Sector! The enemy is
charging in with the Iron Gear
in the lead!!
Heh... So they came west.

Their tactic is a single-point breakthrough!
Their forces will be concentrated there.
Wipe them all out!!

Understood!
I will annihilate the Resistance.

Don't let a single small fry escape!
Make them learn how futile it is
to defy our army!

Yes, sir!
I'll take my leave!

Keep the encirclement intact!
My own escort unit will go
to reinforce the West Sector!

Understood.
I'll bring our ship around
to the West Sector.

All ships, open fire at once!
Stoke the Resistance's terror!
Aaaaaah!!
Gwaaaaah!

Daaamn it!
At this rate,
we're all gonna get wiped out!!

Ugh...
What a bombardment...!

Don't stop!!
Keep pushing forward!!
Enemy ship spotted dead ahead!

Here they come!
We're breaking through in one go!!

rows.notes: Seg 0: location/unit caption, kept on two lines. Seg 6 [jp] -> 'follow up behind it'. Seg 34 [jp]: the three are male (Scott, Roddy, Barts), so 'young men'. Seg 41 Roanne addresses Le Caine as [jp] -> 'Commander'. Seg 55 [jp] (generic Resistance Member) rendered as a neutral scream. | [accuracy 20] direction restored: JP is 'we draw the enemy's attention onto the Janous' (Master Asia's plan), not the Janous acting on its own; sets up Roddy's 'decoy' reply | [accuracy 30] grados-me is a curse at Grados, not an attack call; 'Take this' added an action that is not in the line (they have not engaged yet) | [editorial 41] 'has come out' was flat for an officer's report | [proofread 31] capitalisation: a laugh, not a stutter -- 'Ha-Ha' (likely from the stutter-capital script) is wrong; do not re-capitalise

segments.en:
I won't let you through
that easily...!

Timp!!
Stop them in their tracks!!
Roger...!

Boys! Let's get this started!
Bring out the Walker Machines!
We're backing up the Grados Army!

Heh heh heh heh... Iron Gear...
Ignore my warning and
you won't live long...

Drive off 1 enemy mothership
within the time limit.

Tch!
We can't keep taking this
head-on...!

Fall back and spread out left and right!
Deflect their attack at an angle!!

Pulling off to the flanks, huh...
You're actually pretty sensible.
Who do you think you're talking to!

Pull away from the Iron Gear for now!
We'll hit them in a pincer from both
sides of the siege line!!
Understood.

Fall back, boys!
Hurry and put out those fires!!
Janous: Bridge

Enemy ground forces have entered
from the north side of the base!

Scott!
How is the Janous?

Final checks complete!
We can go anytime!

Mm!
Well done!

Rain!
The time has finally come
to break the seal!
Yes, sir!

Domon!!
Go with Rain!

Master...
What is this seal...?
Go, and you will see!
Yes, Master!

This way... Domon...
Let's hurry!
Right...

Serves you right,
Timp!
You can't beat us anymore!

Heh heh heh heh heh...
You don't get the situation at all...!
What did you say?!

Behind you...
Take a look behind you.

Our plan is to look only forward!
Like I'd turn around!!
Idiot...

rows.notes: Seg 0 caption: [jp] -> 'Janous' per glossary. | [proofread 0] style sheet: location cards use 'Place: Room' ([jp])

segments.en:
Don't bunch up!
You'll draw concentrated fire!
Understood!

To win our freedom,
we have to fight!
Let's do this!

Captain Elchi!
A large enemy ship is approaching
from behind the Iron Gear!
What?!
Enemy reinforcements!!

Before we knew it,
we got half-surrounded from
the left, right and rear...!

Hey!
Aren't we in deep trouble?

If it's come to this,
I'll fight to the bitter end!

The pressure from that ship
behind us is the strongest...
Le Caine!
Looks like it...

Heh heh...
Your tactics won't
work on me!

Die,
you insects!!
Aaaaaah!

It's all right!
It wasn't a direct hit!!

But... that last one
took out the support unit
that was behind us?!

We're stripped bare on land and in the air.
At this rate, we're in trouble.

Damn it~!
You planning to torment us
to death, bit by bit?!

Don't give up!
Just keep moving forward!!

This is the end,
Iron Gear.

Let my golden Zakaal
grace your end with beauty!

<Win Condition>
Shake off the enemy pursuit and get
the mothership out of the battle area.

rows.notes: Seg 12 (Quess, no header) read as her answer to Amuro sensing Le Caine. | [editorial 5] Elchi reacting to a report; 'What did you say!?' read as taking offence

segments.en:
As expected of the Iron Gear...
It seems it won't fall so easily.

But in the end,
it's just a land battleship...

There's no way it can shake off
my fleet's pursuit.

We'll crush them in one blow with the next
attack! Hurry the resupply and
maintenance of every ship!

Lord Le Caine!
A new enemy ship has appeared
behind our vessel!
What?

Fwahahaha!!
You were too eager for victory,
Le Caine!
Who are you?!

I am the Undefeated of the East!
Master Asia!!

Le Caine! You lecture on tactics in front
of me? You're ten years too early for
that, you young whelp!

Heh...
What does a doddering old man with
one foot in the grave think he can do?

Silence!
I'll show you something
you won't forget!!

All units, sortie!!
We will sink the enemy flagship!!
Roger!!
Roger!!
Roger!!

Eijiii!
So that's where you were hiding!

<Win Condition>
Destroy the enemy battleship or
hold the line for a set time.

Oh... I hadn't expected them to
have held back this much strength.

Le Caine!
It's too soon to be surprised!

The weapon we
once cast away...
A sealed power!!

Now we'll show it
to you all!!
Domoooon!!

Right!!
Here I come!!

Hm?!
That machine...!!

What's wrong?
It's just one more
unit, isn't it?
Eahahahaha!
I'll slaughter every last one of you!

Le Caine!
Watch closely!!

If yours is a golden machine,
then mine is the golden finger!

This hand of mine
is burning red!

Its loud roar tells me
to grasp victory!!

Eruuupting Burning...
God Finger!!
Heat End!!
N-No waaay!

Gosterro, of all people,
taken down in one blow?!
He's not to be underestimated!!

Le Caine, we once sealed
away this power
for the sake of peace!

But! We can't allow
Grados's outrages to go
on any longer!!
You had sealed away your power?

It means the people of Terra
aren't as inferior
as you think.

Hah!
Then prove it!!

Call off the attack on the Iron Gear!
Concentrate on the enemy
to our rear!!

Hm?
The enemy's pulling away.

Looks like Master Asia
pulled some kind of trick...

Iron Gear!
Can you hear me!

The enemy's attack is
focused on us!
Go now, while you can!!
B-But...

Go!
We'll be fine!

That's right!
We've got no intention of dying --
not one bit!

We'll meet again!
Say hi to Anna for me!
Eiji...

The Iron Gear and the other
remaining enemy forces are
withdrawing from the battle line.

Leave them!
For now, concentrate your attack
on the enemy behind us!
Yes, sir!

Heh heh... Not bad at all.
No wonder they keep resisting
even with their homeland occupied.

Either way, they will pay
for this humiliation
with their blood!

rows.notes: Segs 13-16: Domon's God Finger chant uses the established English dub wording; [jp] -> 'Erupting Burning God Finger' as in the machine library entry. Seg 12 [jp] -> 'the golden finger'. Seg 18 'He' = Domon (male). Seg 26 [jp] (Amuro) -> 'the commander'. | [accuracy 26] project decision: toho-shirei is written 'Master Asia', not a generic 'the commander' (which also left the referent unclear) | [editorial 31] Domon's voice: 'We haven't the slightest intention' was stiff/formal for his casual ze line

segments.en:
Commander, the operation was a success.
We've drawn plenty of the
enemy's attention.
What became of our other allies?

Most of the base personnel
managed to escape along
with the Iron Gear.

I see...
It's nearly time, then.

Then... as planned...
I'll scuttle the Janous.

Time it with the enemy's
bombardment.
Don't mess it up!
Yeah...!

We did it!!
Direct hit on the enemy ship!!

It doesn't look like a decoy smoke screen.
That should end the enemy's resistance.

Hmm...
At such a disadvantage, they held
out remarkably well.

Enemies though they are,
they deserve our respect.

Thanks to them, our army has suffered
a strategic defeat, after all...
Shall I send out a pursuit force?

No...
That would only add pointless losses.

We will withdraw for now
and rethink our strategy.

Heeey!
No point hanging around here
any longer. Let's get outta here!
Let's go, Roddy.
Okay...

Waaaah!
Don't leave me behind!

Then hurry up
and climb up here,
Scott!
Let us go, Domon.
Yes, Master!

Master... Was this...
really the right thing to do...?
Breaking the seal, you mean?
Yes...

Just as it was
with the Gundam Fights
of the past...

Relying on power only ends up
making the fighting bigger.

It's precisely because
we realized that,
that we cast aside our weapons.
So it was...
Domon...
Goodbye... Janous.
